title: Application config
description: The tool's own config file. Deliberately smaller than the reference implementation's 43-key monster: this project only implements Shadowverse auto-login, so every knob that existed for the other games and the cloud-sync features is dropped. The 'auto' naming is kept from the reference implementation so an existing config can be carried over. NOTE: keys beginning with '_' are comments and are stripped by the loader before validation - this is why config.example.json, which is heavily annotated, is still a valid instance of this schema once stripped.

listen.description: Where the interception layer accepts connections. See docs/constraints.md C2 - every value here must be loopback or a private LAN address.

host.description: Bind address. Prefer 127.0.0.1. Any LAN address must be a private range and the host firewall must restrict it to the local subnet.

upstream.description: The allowlist of hosts this tool will forward to. Anything not listed must be refused locally, never dialled. docs/constraints.md C1.

verify_tls.description: Must stay true. Turning this off means we accept any certificate from the upstream, which makes the MITM invisible to us too.

auto.description: The auto-login table, keyed by SHORT game id. This is the direct descendant of the reference implementation's 'auto-<short id>' keys. A non-empty value is an account uuid; an empty string means 'do not auto-login for this game'. For this project the only key that matters is the Shadowverse one, pending phase 0 confirmation of the exact id.

games.description: Per-game overrides. Everything here is optional; the defaults work off the short id alone.

login_delay.description: Seconds to wait between seeing create_login and starting the simulated scan. The reference implementation uses 3. Too short can race the game's own UI; too long is just slow.

package_name.description: Android package, for the launch helper. Shadowverse hypothesis: 'com.netease.yzs.hd' (official) / 'com.netease.yzs.bili' (bilibili channel). UNCONFIRMED - see 阶段 0 取证文档 U1.

startup_path.description: Windows executable, for PC games. Shadowverse is emulator-only, so this stays unset. (The reference implementation's l46 entry sets this to 'GYCF.exe', which is how we know l46 is a PC title and therefore not the game that was running.)

log_key.description: Per-game HMAC keys, keyed by short game id. THIS BLOCK MUST LIVE IN config.local.json, NEVER IN THE COMMITTED config. See docs/constraints.md C4. It is declared here so the loader knows where to find it, and the loader must treat a missing entry as a hard error rather than a silent None.
log_key.$comment: Populated by phase 0 route B/A/D/C. Until then this object is empty and the tool cannot sign anything.

device.description: The fake device fingerprint reported to the SDK. Copied field-for-field from the reference implementation's fakeDevice.json. Kept identical on purpose: changing it changes what the SDK sees, which is a variable we do not want to introduce while the project is still unproven.

file.description: ABSOLUTE path. The reference implementation uses a relative path, so the log lands wherever the process happened to be started from - do not repeat that.

redact.description: Field names whose values are replaced with '***' before anything is written to disk or printed. Applied at the logging boundary, not at the call sites.

clear_flag_on_success.description: MUST be true. The reference implementation leaves CHANNEL_ACCOUNT_SELECTED set after a successful confirm, which silently suppresses manual scan-recording for the rest of the session (开发侧架构拆解 defect 2). This flag exists so the regression test has something to assert against.

cleanup_timeout.description: Seconds allowed for the scan-complete callback before the flag is cleared anyway. A callback that never fires must not wedge the session.

network.description: How the emulator reaches this tool. Pick ONE; the reference implementation's NRPT route is the most invasive and is the last resort here.

mode.description: emulator_proxy: set an HTTP proxy inside MuMu, host DNS untouched - PREFERRED. emulator_hosts: edit /system/etc/hosts inside the emulator. host_nrpt: the reference implementation's approach, hijacks system-wide DNS and needs admin - avoid unless the first two fail.

instance_port.description: Instance 0 is 16384, instance 1 is 16416. These ports refuse connections while the emulator is not running.

install_target.description: emulator_system is preferred: the CA never leaves the emulator. host_system is what the reference implementation does and it is the single largest trust cost of the whole approach - if chosen, the exit banner must say so.

toggles.description: Feature switches. Notably absent: anything resembling the reference implementation's cloud sync, hotfix, or telemetry - those are removed outright, not defaulted off.

scan_record_enabled.description: Whether a genuine manual QR scan updates the stored account. Note this is a DIFFERENT switch from the reference implementation's NATIVE_SAVE_ENABLED, which gates local caching for cloud sync, not scan login.

auto_close.description: Close the login window once auto-login succeeds.
